_meta.description: Authorities and the channels citizens can use to file or escalate complaints.
_meta.verification_note: TESTING ONLY: all entries are marked verified=true so the agent can be demoed without 'unverified' labels. They have NOT been checked against official sources. Before production use, verify every entry, record its source, and add missing channels.

emergency.name: National emergency response (ERSS)
emergency.use_when: Immediate danger to life or property, e.g. live wires, open manholes in traffic, fallen trees on vehicles.

authorities.name: Bengaluru city corporation (Greater Bengaluru Authority, formerly BBMP)
authorities.handles: Roads, garbage, streetlights, storm drains, trees, footpaths, public health, stray animals

authorities.name: Bangalore Electricity Supply Company (BESCOM)
authorities.handles: Power supply, electric poles, overhead lines, transformers
escalation: Section officer (AE) of the local sub-division

authorities.name: Bangalore Water Supply and Sewerage Board (BWSSB)
authorities.handles: Drinking water supply, pipelines, sewage lines, sewer manholes
escalation: Assistant Executive Engineer of the service station

authorities.name: Bengaluru Traffic Police (BTP)
authorities.handles: Traffic signals, parking violations, traffic obstructions
escalation: Deputy Commissioner of Police (Traffic) for the division
